wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 11-006 wires the MUS lump parser, the per-tic MUS event scheduler, the OPL synth primitives (phase increment, waveform sample, total-level gain, operator combiner), and the musicSystem start/stop/pause/resume/change action machine into a single frozen runtime façade. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/musOplRuntime.ts is a thin pass-through onto the read-only audio primitives — no additional state is allocated. The façade is frozen so downstream subsystems cannot replace the method references.
publicSurface: MusOplRuntime interface (parseMus, createScheduler, advanceScheduler, createMusicSystem, startMusic, stopMusic, pauseMusic, resumeMusic, changeMusic, setMusicVolume, advanceMusic, isMusicPlaying, resolveMusicNumber, computePhaseIncrement, computeWaveformSample, computeTotalLevelGain, combineOperators)
crossPlanInventoryUpdates: src/audio/musParser.ts: src_importer_count 2→3, test_importer_count 7→8 (musOplRuntime.ts indirect via reexport)
